title: The dock outlives the world change

members.role: the chart card enters and is kept: its exit (70.9) lies past this scene's span - record and stack payloads hold the same way
the world changes underneath the held card, a wipe rather than a plain cut - 16 ordered fires in Steel; the dock's own exit is not a card, it is simply later

does: One piece of evidence carries a whole paragraph: the card enters, the room wipes or cuts away beneath it, and the same card is still standing in the next room (8.7-50.7 s, up to 3 cuts).
